what: Re-check published articles against the printed margins (TRANSLATING.md, 'Re-checking a published article'). Work in order.

items.note: Re-checked 2026-11-12 (by hand, as the model for later runs). Added 69 reference-only markers from the margin (the margin's numerals were often misread by margins.py: e.g. 'II Reg.' read as 3 Kings, 'Josue ... Ibid.' as Job; each verse was checked against the Latin) and one lemma (1:17 in para 23). No margin note read, kept as quoted word for word (check against the scan, PDF 25-33): Ecclus 24:5, Wis 7:25, Wis 7:26, Gen 15:1, Gen 21:12, Gen 21:6, John 19:17, Luke 2:10, Luke 2:11. Margin notes citing only a chapter are given as verse 1 (Gen 48:1, Gen 49:1). Para 9 has a note where the margin is partly unreadable; para 29 notes III Esdras iv-v (not in this Bible).

Margin references from PDF 32 above the heading belong to Art. I and were left out. Numerals read as: 'Luc. ii, 31' -> Luke 3:31; 'I Par. xvi, 17' -> 1 Par 18:17 (kept tag); 'Prov. iv, 4' -> Prov 4:4; 'Ibid. 17, 18' -> 1 Par 3:17-18; 'Luc. i, 97, 63' -> Luke 1:57, 63; Num 36:6-9 marked at 36:6 and 36:8. Unread note 'II Reg. xi(i), 5' beside Bethsabee's first son (PDF 34) left untagged: 2 Kings 11:5 or 12:15?

Margin notes on PDF 36 R (Art. II) and PDF 41 (Art. IV) left out. Kept tags whose margin notes were misread: Luke 5:8 ('Luc. 9,8'), Is 52:6 ('Is. lii, 6'), Zach 3:9 ('8, 9'), Is 53:2 ('Is. liii, 2'), 2 Kings 20:9, Is 49:1. Added Heb 10:13 beside the 1 Cor 15:25 blend (note updated). Ex 13:2 is a guess for a part-unread 'Ibid. xiii(?)' (PDF 40); Matt 12:46 and 13:55 read from 'Matth. xii, 46; xiii, 55' (OCR 'x', '93'). Exod. xxxiv margin beside Moses' face: only 34:30 marked (the further verse numbers unreadable).

Margin notes on PDF 40 (Art. III) and PDF 46 (Art. V) left out. Reference-only markers from unread or part-read notes: Acts 12:2, 12:4 ('Act. xii, 4-'), Acts 12:23, Dan 9:24 ('ix, 24-'?), Gen 35:19 ('Gen. xxxv, 19'), Is 48:11 ('xlviii, 11'). 1 Esd 2 (chapter only) given as 2:1; a second note beside the Machabees ('II, vii'?, PDF 41 R) left unread. Ex 8:7, 18, 19 (unread '7, 18, 19' after Ex 7:11, 22) not marked. No margin note read for Mich 5:2 in para 12 (Denis's second rendering of Micah) and 1 Cor 3:10, 12 (margin 'I Cor. iii, 10, 12' misread): kept.
